related.title: 白光干涉表面輪廓儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「低同調干涉與軸向解析度」與「靈敏度、散粒雜訊極限與功率預算」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；白光干涉表面輪廓儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Low-coherence interference and axial resolution" and "Sensitivity, shot-noise limit and power budget" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of White-light interferometric profilometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦低同調干涉的軸向解析度、頻域深度範圍、靈敏度衰減與色散預算；白光干涉表面輪廓儀則以低相干包絡定位、Mirau 干涉物鏡、垂直掃描與 ISO 25178 計量特性校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on axial resolution of low-coherence interferometry, Fourier-domain depth range, sensitivity roll-off and dispersion budgets; White-light interferometric profilometers centres on low-coherence envelope localisation, Mirau interference objectives, vertical scanning and ISO 25178 metrological-characteristic calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「寬頻光源與同調包絡」與「寬頻光源與零光程差包絡」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到白光干涉表面輪廓儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「蝙蝠翼、異材相位與薄膜干擾」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Broadband source and coherence envelope” and “Broadband source and zero-OPD envelope”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to White-light interferometric profilometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Batwing artefacts, dissimilar-material phase and thin-film interference", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.difference: 本課聚焦低同調干涉的軸向解析度、頻域深度範圍、靈敏度衰減與色散預算；傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀則以麥克森干涉儀、氦氖取樣、解析度與訊雜比交換的 FTIR 工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on axial resolution of low-coherence interferometry, Fourier-domain depth range, sensitivity roll-off and dispersion budgets; Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers centres on michelson interferometer, HeNe sampling, resolution and signal-to-noise trade-offs in FTIR engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「寬頻光源與同調包絡」與「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雜訊、掃描次數與解析度的交換」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Broadband source and coherence envelope” and “Michelson interferometer and interferogram”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Noise, scan averaging and the resolution trade", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光學同調斷層掃描
history.text: 1991 年 Huang、Swanson、Fujimoto 等人在麻省理工學院與哈佛醫學院合作發表時域 OCT，以低同調干涉對視網膜與動脈進行微米級斷層成像；1996 年第一台商用眼科 OCT 問世。2003 年前後 Leitgeb、de Boer、Choma 等團隊證明頻域偵測的靈敏度優勢，使光譜域與掃頻 OCT 在 2006 年後成為眼科標準檢查，並擴展到心血管內視鏡與工業量測。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何廠商的專有設計。
history.textEn: In 1991 Huang, Swanson, Fujimoto and colleagues at MIT with Harvard Medical School published time-domain OCT, using low-coherence interferometry for micrometre-scale tomography of the retina and arteries; the first commercial ophthalmic OCT appeared in 1996. Around 2003 the groups of Leitgeb, de Boer and Choma demonstrated the sensitivity advantage of Fourier-domain detection, after which spectral-domain and swept-source OCT became a standard ophthalmic examination from about 2006 and spread to intravascular endoscopy and industrial metrology. This course rebuilds only public principles and engineering logic, not any vendor's proprietary design.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「低同調干涉與軸向解析度」到「深度比例尺校正、假體驗證與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Low-coherence interference and axial resolution" through "Depth-scale calibration, phantom validation and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
